sources.title: tc-netem(8) — Linux manual page
evidence_used: netem can emulate delay, loss, corruption, duplication, reordering, rate, slotting, and seeded randomness
kernel timer granularity and queue placement are limitations that must be reported
sources.design_decision: Use Linux netem for the minimum pilot; log both configured values and achieved measurements.

sources.title: ns-3 Documentation
evidence_used: ns-3 provides tutorials, a reference manual, a model library, and API documentation for network simulation
sources.design_decision: Reserve ns-3 for later protocol-level studies instead of duplicating simulators in the minimum pilot.

sources.title: ACM Artifact Review and Badging - Current
evidence_used: functional artifacts are documented, consistent, complete, exercisable, and include verification and validation evidence
sources.design_decision: Use these dimensions as internal acceptance targets without claiming an ACM badge or external audit.

sources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
evidence_used: dataset documentation should cover motivation, composition, collection process, recommended uses, assumptions, and limitations
sources.design_decision: Include a dataset card that is completed throughout collection and maintenance.
